definition: A ghostly figure that appears suddenly or mysteriously.
author: Washington Irving
quote: The dominant spirit, however, that haunts this enchanted region, and seems to be commander-in-chief of all the powers of the air, is the apparition of a figure on horseback, without a head.
example_sentence: A pale apparition seemed to drift across the landing.
